chunks: Will you dispute with him what he saw?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by disputing with the Prophet over what he saw?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the authority of the Prophet's direct spiritual experience (kashf) against the skepticism of the Quraysh, often linking it to the concept of Ismah (infallibility) which guarantees the accuracy of his testimony. It serves as a rhetorical challenge, implying that since the Prophet witnessed what he did, their arguments are baseless disputes over divine truth rather than logical debate.
